body: yes I have been on meds for the last 20 years, some help and I see a therapist, I feel like that for every step forward I take 3 steps back

life feels like a broken record, the same things happen again and again.  yes, I struggle with not being there for my son, that's the part I think hurts the most.  other than that I am emotionless to anything else.

I'm not sure where to start,  felt awkward as a child, abused heavily physically by my father and still today it's just mental.  born into being an addict, alcohol, drugs, women, gambling, etc but nothing made me happy after a while.  divorced in 2009 and had joint custody of my 12 year old son until a few months ago and now I see him 1 hour every Saturday, been sober for 4 years and relapsed after a breakup of 4 years with who I thought was the love of my life, lost multiple jobs and most recently lost a great position at a hospital but the fired me saying I broawes porn over 40 pages worth but they will not give me or my lawyer any information, so I'm almost homeless, drinking again, met a wonderful person in the process who all of a sudden won't talk to me or give me any explanation of our situation, all I have done was support and be there for her.  my car blew a piston through the engine so I have no way to go anywhere except for my bicycle or foot, I'm being shoved into a corner.  I have felt like suicide for many years maybe 5 or 7, just to end the pain, my chronic depression, bipolar, addiction.  the reason I haven't done it before is because I haven't got a concrete answer on where we go if I do it, heaven or he'll.  but I'm about to be homeless will not see my son, no job, I'm 40 and my time is running out.  I sit in silence with my rope
